domain_title: Purpose, value, context, roles and classification
title: Superficial or static classification
canonical_definition: Classification is copied, model-centric, overconfident or treated as a one-time formality.

conditions: All AI systems; classification must be revisited after material change.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Superficial or static classification: Classification is copied, model-centric, overconfident or treated as a one-time formality.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show copied vendor categories, internal ratings treated as legal class, or missing reclassification after change?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Superficial or static classification, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Vendor category copied without use analysis
Internal rating confused with legal class
Unknown legal questions stated as facts

conditions: Refer verified superficial or static classification to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.1 (PDF p. 27), MAP 1.1 (PDF p. 31), MAP 4.1 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on identifying applicable requirements and mapping legal risk in deployment context. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where a classification copied from a provider or based on an internal score without assessment of the actual use. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a change to affected users, intended use or territory proceeded without reclassification, or an unresolved legal question was recorded as settled.
potential_consequences: A transition may proceed under obligations derived from the wrong use context.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether a classification copied from a provider or based on an internal score without assessment of the actual use. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a change to affected users, intended use or territory proceeded without reclassification, or an unresolved legal question was recorded as settled. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review a current reconstruction for sampled use contexts that reconciles source facts, legal review records, obligations and changes. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether a classification copied from a provider or based on an internal score without assessment of the actual use. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a change to affected users, intended use or territory proceeded without reclassification, or an unresolved legal question was recorded as settled. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide a current reconstruction for sampled use contexts that reconciles source facts, legal review records, obligations and changes. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: A current reconstruction for sampled use contexts that reconciles source facts, legal review records, obligations and changes.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether a classification copied from a provider or based on an internal score without assessment of the actual use, and separately check whether a change to affected users, intended use or territory proceeded without reclassification, or an unresolved legal question was recorded as settled. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use a current reconstruction for sampled use contexts that reconciles source facts, legal review records, obligations and changes. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A preliminary classification can be valid within its declared scope when unresolved questions visibly constrain progression.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in A4 alone cannot establish AP-A4 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows superficial or static classification
Implementation or operating evidence shows superficial or static classification
Presence or tested absence of superficial or static classification is unresolved within scope
